verdict.rationale: Mercury's own materials document granular user permissions, approval controls on payments, and organization approval policies. A customer quote says built-in permissions let an accountant make payments in one click. However, the evidence is mostly marketing-level and never documents how a finance lead configures approver roles or designates who may approve and send. missing for 10: first-party docs on configuring approval permissions and designating approvers, documented one-click approve-and-send flow beyond a testimonial, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set up approval permissions so designated teammates can approve and send payments with one click

citations.quote: Built-in permissions means our accountant can easily make payments — literally one click and it’s done.
Curb team spend with card limits, spend controls, and granular user permissions.
Pay recipients from your Mercury accounts over ACH, check, domestic wire, and international wire, with optional approval controls.
Create a "request to send money" that will require approval based on your organization's approval policies.
Queue transactions via API for manual review and sign-off inside the Mercury dashboard prior to release of funds.
